query:
UPDATE users
               SET last_known_ip = $1,
                   last_seen_at = NOW(),
                   country_id = $2,
                   region_id = $3,
                   city_id = $4,
                   locked = $5,
                   session_version = session_version + CASE WHEN $5 AND NOT locked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
             WHERE id = $6
